items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 21 at 6:55PM PDT until October 24 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 34 to 36 degrees will result in frost
formation.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Oregon and southwest
Washington.

* WHEN...From 11 PM Friday to 9 AM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender outdoor plants from the cold.
Consider temporarily moving outdoor potted plants indoors if they are
sensitive to cold temperatures.

Consider temporarily covering sensitive plants with a lightweight
cotton fabric (i.e., bedsheets, thin blankets), as this will help
retain heat and provide frost protection for your plants.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 21 at 1:30PM PDT until October 22 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, seas 6 to 9 ft at 13
seconds and north winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt
expected. For the Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and
hazardous seas 8 to 11 ft at 9 seconds and north winds 10 to 20
kt with gusts up to 25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Falcon to Cape Foulweather OR
out 10 NM, Coastal waters from Cape Foulweather to Florence OR
out 10 NM and Waters from Cape Foulweather to Florence OR from
10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Small Craft Advisory, from 11 AM to 8 PM PDT Thursday.
Hazardous Seas Warning, from 8 PM Thursday to 8 AM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Very steep and hazardous seas could capsize or cause
damage to vessels.
items.instruction:
A Hazardous Seas Warning means hazardous sea conditions are
imminent or occurring. Recreational boaters should remain in
port, or take shelter until waves subside.  Commercial vessels
should prepare for rough seas and consider remaining in port or
taking shelter in port until hazardous seas subside.
